content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms offer a streamlined approach to selling digital products, including automated delivery and payment processing. However, these services come with significant restrictions, particularly for users in regions where they do not operate. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH provides a comprehensive suite of tools that empower creators to set up their stores independently. With solutions like the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack, users can quickly deploy their digital storefronts without the constraints imposed by traditional platforms, enjoying full ownership and operational sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access based on geographical location, operating in only 46 countries out of 195 globally. This exclusion effectively disenfranchises numerous creators who cannot access their services. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to function irrespective of geographical limitations. It enables creators in restricted countries to establish fully operational stores without relying on platforms that impose barriers, thereby supporting their right to sell and thrive in the digital marketplace. This architecture ensures that financial isolation is no longer a barrier to entry.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment processors often impose high transaction fees and can take days to process payments, particularly in countries with less favorable banking systems. PayPal, for instance, can freeze accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days, causing financial strain. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a different model altogether, utilizing NOWPayments for crypto transactions with only a 0.5% fee and instantaneous payment confirmations. This approach not only reduces costs but also enhances cash flow, allowing creators to receive payments without the delays and uncertainties associated with conventional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital products and customer data is a critical concern for creators. With platforms like Lemon Squeezy and PayPal, users often relinquish control over their data and sales processes. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators own their entire stack, from the domain to the payment processing. This ownership translates into greater security and autonomy, allowing for automated delivery of products using free tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Creators can focus on their craft without worrying about platform dependencies or restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on individual needs and technical ability. For those looking for a quick and simple setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a rapid deployment solution. For more advanced creators needing additional features and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack is the ideal choice. Both options bypass traditional barriers, ensuring that creators can operate and grow their businesses without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms. The decision ultimately hinges on the level of control and features desired by the creator.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Traditional platforms impose barriers; choose a stack that guarantees your ownership.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell and prepare the necessary files. Choose between the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack based on your needs. Follow the deployment instructions to set up your online store using free hosting and payment solutions. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Test your store to ensure product delivery and payment processes are functioning correctly.
